fixed.problem: L4i-left-59 (L4a-left-7, L4c-left-12, carried twice; money, never cut): a critic review that met the subscription's plan share paused the task as at a budget ('"X" is done; its review waits for room in your Claude subscription's share' with a budget card that waited for the 1st), whatever the person's credential policy said (the owner's D5: 'Running out includes a usage limit, a plan-share cap and a monthly cap ... Whatever the policy says is what happens').
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/critic-review-share.test.ts 'under 'then the API key' the review goes on on the key: the task is done, no budget card, its review's cost on the task' (failed before: needs_human with the budget card); the file has four composed cases: then the key (cost on the task and the session), ask (one ask card, nothing reaches the key, compose twice keeps the same card and hold), wait (waits for Tue 1 Dec, nothing moves after a restart), and the task's own budget binding first (budget pause at its budget, no key call)
fixed.how: Root cause: the hooks' plan level refuses the review's next call with budget_exceeded level 'plan'; reviewRefusalOf read it as a budget refusal and runner.ts reviewStopSource mapped 'plan' to a budget stop. Now loop/critic.ts catches a plan-level refusal and asks the critic's routed provider (session/review-refusal.ts shareGoesOn): when the policy lets another credential take over now, the review is made once more there, capped at what is left of the task's own budget after the refused calls; else withReviewWait turns it into the credential's wait (reason 'share', code provider_usage_limit, project kept on the source, one ask card under 'ask'), so the runner's existing credential branch lets the task wait. runner.ts reviewStopSource and the review budget stop are unchanged.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Live (real model, real subscription): Settings > Which Claude does the work: 'Subscription first, then API key'; set the subscription's allowance low (Settings, the plan allowance) so a task's work fits under Forerunner's share but its review crosses it; Start the project. Expect: no Inbox card 'its review waits for room in your Claude subscription's share'; the task ends Done with its review on the API key; the task's cost and the session's spend include both review parts. Repeat with 'then ask me first': one card 'Use your API key until <1st>?' with Use API key / Wait, the task row 'Waits for your answer: use your API key?', nothing reaches the key until answered; Quit and reopen: the same one card. Repeat with 'then wait': the row 'Waits until <1st> (your subscription's share)', nothing moves.
